Watermark

Auto: the spinning logo shows in the corner whenever nothing else is on screen.

Esc removes everything from the screen.

Connection

In OBS: Tools › WebSocket Server Settings › tick Enable WebSocket server, then Show Connect Info for the port and password. Use localhost when this panel runs on the streaming computer; otherwise use that computer's IP address. Keep the channel main unless you run more than one overlay setup.

Profiles

A profile keeps everything you set up: saved speakers, messages and verses (with their MIDI notes), what is typed in each card, positions, the watermark, the full-screen screen wording, MIDI note settings and scene choices — e.g. one for the English service and one for the Spanish service.

Export / import

Exports are .json files you can import on another computer. They also carry this computer's connection and MIDI settings. Importing updates a profile with the same name and adds new ones.

MIDI

Send a MIDI note when you show or remove something — e.g. to trigger ProPresenter. ProPresenter uses the note to pick the action and the velocity to pick which item (1 = first). Use loopMIDI (Windows) or the IAC Driver (Mac) as the MIDI port, and run this panel in Chrome or Edge.

Off

Not sure which note names ProPresenter uses? Press Test on a row and check which action fires, or type plain note numbers (0–127).
